fields.label: Company
fields.description: The payer company issuing the mandate. Row scoping runs through this Company via active Employee records.
Why this surveillance was dispatched (claim reference, suspicion basis) — the claim stays context here, never a data surface.
fields.label: Reason

fields.description: The in-scope patient/visit identifiers this mandate covers (at least one line).
fields.label: Scope Lines

fields.description: Unguessable 8-char code (secrets.token_hex(4) uppercased) — the QR payload; returned in full only to the issuer.
fields.label: Short Code

fields.description: Deep link to the mandate verification flow for the officer's scan handler.
fields.label: QR URL

fields.description: Optional per-mandate geofence override in kilometres (else: facility radius, then settings default).
fields.label: Radius (km)

fields.description: Per-mandate override of the settings location policy: strict blocks an off-fence check-in, flag records and continues.
fields.label: Location Policy

fields.description: HMAC-SHA256 over the mandate binding fields with the site key — tamper-evidence for exports.
fields.label: Signature

fields.description: Consecutive failed verify_mandate attempts for this code; resets on a successful verification.
fields.label: Verify Attempts

fields.description: Set once the strike count reaches the lockout threshold; while set, every verification attempt is rejected, including the assigned officer.
fields.label: Verify Locked
